Find the sum of genes elevated in the fore brain in humans, pigs and mice:

```{r}
h_cerebral_cortex <- 180
h_basal_ganglia <- 83
h_thalamus <- 57
h_hypothalamus <- 110
Human_genes <- sum(h_cerebral_cortex,h_basal_ganglia,h_thalamus,h_hypothalamus)
print(Human_genes)

p_cerebral_cortex <- 109
p_basal_ganglia <- 157
p_thalamus <- 31
p_hypothalamus <- 45
pig_genes <- sum(p_cerebral_cortex,p_basal_ganglia,p_thalamus,p_hypothalamus)
print(pig_genes)

m_cerebral_cortex <- 55
m_basal_ganglia <- 185
m_thalamus <- 60
m_hypothalamus <- 98
mice_genes <- sum(m_cerebral_cortex,m_basal_ganglia,m_thalamus,m_hypothalamus)
print(mice_genes)
```

Humans have the largest number of regionally elevated genes in the fore brain
